subtitle: Out Manila · Air China / China Eastern Airlines
overview: Fly to Harbin and stay four nights in a 5★ hotel for the Harbin winter: Ice-Snow World, the Siberian Tiger Park, Chateau Volga, Sophia Church Square and a chocolate workshop. The package includes a free meal upgrade to an Ice Palace hot pot and a barbecue, and an English-speaking guide with private coach. Air China flies via Beijing and China Eastern via Shanghai.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 22–26 2026 to Feb 11–15 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A park near Harbin that breeds Siberian tigers, visited with a safari-style viewing experience.
placeDesc.Harbin Ice-Snow World: A large winter theme park in Harbin with giant ice and snow sculptures.
placeDesc.Chateau Volga: A Russian-style themed estate in Harbin with replica buildings and gardens.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian-style church replica at Chateau Volga, visited on the tour.
placeDesc.Vodka Fort: A themed vodka fort at Chateau Volga where the tour includes a small vodka and snack.
placeDesc.Pushkin Exhibition Hall: An exhibition hall at Chateau Volga themed on the Russian poet Alexander Pushkin.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's historic pedestrian street lined with European-style buildings.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park in Harbin along the Songhua River.
placeDesc.Flood Control Monument: A monument on the Songhua River bank in Harbin built to commemorate flood control efforts.
placeDesc.Sophia Church Square: The square around Harbin's well-known Byzantine-style Saint Sophia Cathedral.
placeDesc.Middle East Railway Bridge: A historic railway bridge over the Songhua River near Harbin.
placeDesc.Songhua River Cable Car: An optional cable car ride across the Songhua River in Harbin.
placeDesc.Harbin Grand Theatre: A modern landmark theatre in Harbin, seen from outside; part of an optional tour.
